data.narrative:
Xage Security is a Series B-stage defense and security company that has raised $80M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms operating in Defense & Security, including Dream Security, Harmattan AI, Code Metal, Defense Unicorns, and Heven AeroTech.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression modeling uses the $80M total raised as a proxy base and applies a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B-to-later-stage step-ups, yielding $152M. Peer-median analysis references 6 same-sector, same-stage comparables with a median valuation of $1.1B, anchored by a peer range of $300M to $3.0B. The peer set includes valuations at $3.0B (Dream Security), $1.4B (Harmattan AI), $1.2B (Code Metal), and $1.0B each for Defense Unicorns and Heven AeroTech.

Triangulating these two methods produces a valuation range of $129M (low) to $1.3B (high), with a median of $638M. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty around whether Xage's risk profile and market position align with the lower or upper quartile of the peer set. Key sensitivities include revenue traction, customer concentration, and competitive positioning relative to the $1.0B–$3.0B cohort in the comparables universe.
